metas.name: Least Eligible Bachelor
metas.description: A bachelor struggling to find a bride because of his looks moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start, only to discover that his potential match is his colleague at work.

metas.name: Nuvvu Nenu Prema
metas.description: When destiny brings Padmavathi, a lively girl and Vikramaditya, a haughty businessman to cross paths, they realise that they cannot live without each other.

metas.name: Seethe Ramudi Katnam
metas.description: Circumstances compel Ram to marry Seetha, a plain-looking girl, but his stepmother refuses to accept her as her daughter-in-law. How will Seetha convince his family about her worth?

metas.name: Pallakilo Pellikuturu
metas.description: A modern and independent Sasirekha meets Abhiram, a man of traditions. Forced into marriage, can they find their happily ever after?

metas.name: Amrutham
metas.description: Amrutham is a popular sitcom in Telugu. It was produced by Just Yellow Media. It was the longest running and most popular sitcom in Telugu.

metas.name: Vantalakka
metas.description: After Murali's untimely death, Varalakshmi restarts her life and finds herself at odds with Vishnu, her imperious boss. Can this hate ever turn into love?

metas.name: 3 Roses
metas.description: Story of 3 best friends – Ritu, Jhanvi, and Indu who reunite when their families call them back to Hyderabad to get the girls married & settled. During this process, they happen to witness a series of events that change their life.

metas.name: Vikram On Duty
metas.description: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

metas.name: Maa Annayya
metas.description: Gangadhar, an elder brother to four girls, dedicates his life to raising them and getting them married. However, his perspective changes when he learns about their ambitions.

metas.name: Mass Jathara
metas.description: Get ready for a comedy carnival! Talented teams perform hilarious skits, competing to deliver the biggest laughs. With Jani Master, Navdeep, and Bindu Madhavi judging the fun, expect witty banter, energetic acts, and nonstop entertainment.

metas.name: Super Subbu
metas.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

metas.name: Jabilli Kosam Aakashamalle
metas.description: As promised to her adoptive mother, Jabilli sets out to search for her cousin brother. The search leads her to discover her true identity.

metas.name: Jagamae Sangeetham
metas.description: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

metas.name: Second Marriage
metas.description: Second Marriage is an emotional romantic comedy about two beautifully imperfect people who give marriage another chance. Packed with quirky humor, heartfelt emotions, and relatable moments, the series feels like a warm hug.

metas.name: Muthyamantha Muddu
metas.description: Geetha decides to not get married for fear of her parents being neglected. Govind falls in love with her and promises to let her parents stay with them, without realising its consequences.

metas.name: Brinda
metas.description: Young, socially awkward yet morally grounded SI cadet Brinda stumbles upon a brutal murder with a chilling modus operandi. As the killer slips through her grasp, she faces personal and bureaucratic turmoil, but the hardest challenge is the moral reckoning that could define her career and conscience. Will Brinda uphold justice, or lose herself in the chaos closer to home?

metas.name: Ennenno Janmala Bandham
metas.description: Yash loves his daughter, Khushi, but fails to express himself. Vedaswini adores the kid, which makes Yash envy her. Can Khushi bring these lonely hearts closer?

metas.name: Mansion 24
metas.description: When Kalidas, one of the most revered archaeologists in the country, accused of stealing precious artefacts and fleeing the country, his daughter Amrutha an investigative journalist, enters an abandoned mansion with a frightening past, to trace his whereabouts and restore his legacy.

metas.name: Aakali Rajyam
metas.description: Three friends, one fresh start, and a life full of unexpected challenges. As job struggles, money problems, and personal battles push them to the edge, can their friendship and a bold new dream change their lives?

metas.name: Brahma Mudi
metas.description: The lives of Kavya and her sisters change forever as they cross paths with the Duggiraala brothers. As fate brings them closer, what's in store for them?

metas.name: 11th Hour
metas.description: Aratika Reddy is the CEO of Aditya Group and has a day to pay a debt of Rs 10,000 Cr. With rivals breathing down her neck to take over the company, stakes are high as she runs against time to save the day.

metas.name: Janaki Ramayya Gari Manavaralu
metas.description: Purushottam, the successor of a wealthy family, is over-pampered and grows up to be gullible. He later falls in love with Mythili, but will their love story survive class conflict and family disputes?

metas.name: Baahubali: Crown of Blood
metas.description: A dark chapter in the Mahishmati kingdom's history that became its greatest challenge and shaped the future of its two princes, Baahubali and Bhallaladeva.

metas.name: Objection, My Lord!
metas.description: A father burns himself alive outside the Hyderabad High Court, demanding justice for his missing daughter, Sameera. When the system moves on and forgets, one question remains.Did Sameera ever exist? A forgotten lawyer, Parshuram, is forced out of self imposed exile to fight for the answer.

metas.name: The Baker and the Beauty
metas.description: Baker and the Beauty is the story of a super model Aira and a very poor baker Vijju. Both are in constant search for true love. Because of their overwhelming class, caste, religious, economic and social differences, this relationship almost becomes impossible at any given time. On top of that, Aira & Vijju are constantly being separated by Vijju’s obsessive girlfriend and Aira’s overprotective manager. By the end, how Aira & Vijju navigate these obstacles to discover their true love forms the crux of the main plot.

metas.name: Devika & Danny
metas.description: Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

metas.name: Parampara
metas.description: When powerful, wily Naidu's ruthlessness becomes too much, his nephew, Gopi, steps up to avenge the injustice met to his father.

metas.name: High Priestess
metas.description: Revolves around Swathi Reddy, a tarot card reader and psychic, who deals with peculiar cases and clients that make her experience supernatural powers around her.

metas.name: Isakapatnam
metas.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

metas.name: AIR
metas.description: Three boys. One elite college. A system that demands perfection. Arjun, Imran, and Raju come from different worlds but share one secret: they don’t want to be here. As rebellion sparks friendship, their bond deepens amid pressure, heartbreak, and identity struggles. Guided by a radical teacher with a troubled past, they must decide who they truly are—beyond marks and expectations.

metas.name: Madhuranagarilo
metas.description: Sparks fly when Shyam comes across Radha, a new tenant from his colony. However, their love story takes a backseat as a hidden secret from the past resurfaces.

metas.name: Hello World
metas.description: Eight youngsters join a renowned IT company assuming that their struggles are over. But, their excitement is short-lived when they realise that life has more in store for them than they had imagined.

metas.name: Part-Timers
metas.description: Two roommates, worlds apart, barely stay together. But these two women share one grand dream: a start-up.

metas.name: Kotha Poradu
metas.description: This story revolves around Raju, a care-free villager who is new to the city. While his struggle seems to be never-ending, fate has a different plan in store for him.

metas.name: Dhootha
metas.description: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

metas.name: Save the Tigers
metas.description: Revolves around three frustrated husbands who meet by chance and how their rants over their marital problems set off a series of crazy events.

metas.name: Bad Trip
metas.description: A shared cab ride presents a group of people the opportunity to get rich quickly. What seems like an easy job turns into a web of nightmares for the gang.

metas.name: Hometown
metas.description: A filmmaker revisits his hometown, remembering childhood moments that shaped him - first love, lasting friendships, his initial plane ride, and early heartaches that influenced who he became.

metas.name: Loser
metas.description: Loser is a 2020 ZEE5 Telugu Original series starring Priyadarshi, Annie, Kalpika, and Shashank. Set between 1980 and 2000, this sports drama narrates the story of 3 players struggling to succeed in their game, each during a different time frame, and their lives eventually colliding with each other.

metas.name: Thulasivanam
metas.description: This IPL season meet the Party animal Thulasi Ram from Thulasivanam.

metas.name: Pitta Kathalu
metas.description: Four different women, four journeys of love and betrayal. The common thread? They all want to dismantle the patriarchy.

metas.name: Radhaku Neevera Pranam
metas.description: Radhika, a sketch artist, and Karthik, a no-nonsense police officer, are pulled together by fate when a tragic incident changes their lives.

metas.name: Oka Chinna Family Story
metas.description: Mahesh and his mother embark on an adventurous journey filled with hilarious situations as they try to make quick money to repay a huge loan.

metas.name: Shaitan
metas.description: After attempting an attack on the Home Minister, Baali is on the run. What happens when he chooses the path of violence?...

metas.name: Panchanama
metas.description: Police officer Jai Ram refuses to accept his brother Aadi's death as an accident. His investigation leads him to reopen other suspicious death cases involving Aadi, Praveen and Joseph, eventually uncovering a much larger conspiracy connected to a medical syndicate.

metas.name: The Guest
metas.description: The Guest is Telugu Indian drama thriller webseries produced by Tamada media.

metas.name: Anveshana
metas.description: An undercover investigating organization called UBI , is secretly operating in india with no one having clue about it except the agents themselves.One among the expert level agents is Mr.Ravi who works for UBI under a psuedo identity - Agent chanakya.Watch Anveshana , a spy comedy thriller webseries which deals with exposing the Honeytrap mafia.

metas.name: The Mystery of Moksha Island
metas.description: A lavish inheritance and a pharma empire lure a dead scientist's relatives to a remote island. The excitement turns into horror when they realise it's a trap.

metas.name: Veerabhadruni Rahasyam
metas.description: A city woman challenges a village’s deadly superstitions, uncovering deep crimes behind local myths.

metas.name: Yakshini
metas.description: A spirit named Maya, cursed to live among mortals as punishment for a wicked deed, embarks on a mission to sacrifice 100 men to save her kind, but her resolve wavers when she encounters a kind-hearted young man named Krishna.

metas.name: Meet Cute
metas.description: Meet Cute takes you through five instances of Two strangers, unexpectedly, find solace in each other’s company while navigating through tricky phases in their lives, helping them look at themselves and their loved ones in a different light.

metas.name: Yeda Loyallo Indradhanasu
metas.description: On her journey to become an outstanding teacher, Amulya finds herself in the crosshairs of her corrupt boss. How will she surpass the challenges thrown her way?

metas.name: Arabia Kadali
metas.description: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

metas.name: G.O.D - Gods Of Dharmapuri
metas.description: Set in the 1960s and 1970s, the story revolves around the mining mafia bubble that takes Pratap Reddy from rags to riches, as he seeks control over Dharmapuri through sheer violence and ruthlessness. The situation, however, changes when Pratap becomes the target of his friends and family.

metas.name: Mrs. Subbalakshmi
metas.description: Revolves around a woman struggling to free herself from the daily doldrums of marriage. After her workaholic husband, who barely notices her, forgets their wedding anniversary, Subbu takes her friend's well-intentioned advice and decides to take a day off for herself. The series then follows her one-day escapade.

metas.name: Hey Krishna
metas.description: Krishna, a 25-year-old engineering graduate, leads a boring life as every girl he tries to impress rejects him. A series of incidents makes him believe that lord Krishna is the root cause of his love life troubles and takes a drastic decision that alters his life forever.
